rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It did not describe visible features, so accuracy is preserved but not thorough.
It comprehensively integrated age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, diagnosis, and cycle history into prognosis and transfer expectations.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability estimates logically tied to age and presumed embryo quality. Minor overreach exists around effects of stress/alcohol and assumptions about expected blastocyst numbers.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but some recommendations are weakly evidence-based or not routinely guideline-supported in this setting (e.g., ERA after one failure, thrombophilia/NK testing, acupuncture emphasis, speculative estradiol addition).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer monitoring, luteal support, and future cycle considerations, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
